this site runs the toolkit's Caddy, and admitting it needs --public-ports
The request is for site watch (roles: monitor). The gateway, or a monitor with web_server.managed_by: paisans, binds ports 80 and 443. --public-ports lowers net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start to 80 for the whole host, so every local user may then bind ports 80 to 1023, and opens 80 and 443 in the firewall. Admit it with --public-ports, or do not admit it; a monitor behind your own web server (web_server.managed_by: external) needs neither. Nothing was read or changed.
